g.text: Standardized cue angles · Retained activity orientation
Exact prepared basals; all four requested cue-centre angles, including initial overlaps. Readout after 13,000 cue-free units.
Shared centre angles retain native physical cue widths and peaks; neither cue footprint nor native clocks are matched across models.
Lines connect tested points. Open markers fail the separate full-field tail gate; reused primary-only histories have no invented full-field flag.
Initial support–core overlap occurs at: WP 45°/22.5°; Holmes 45°/22.5°; Spring 90°/45°/22.5°. No overlap conditions were excluded.
